title: Directory submission profile
description: Minimum reusable product facts gathered from the product site and user before submissions. Keep this file local because it contains a contact email.

name.description: Product name exactly as it should appear in listings.

tagline.description: One-line pitch, under 10 words where possible.

url.description: Canonical product URL after redirects; prefer HTTPS when the site serves it.

utm_source_placeholder.description: Value used as utm_medium when building per-directory URLs.

short_description.description: 60–120 char description for fields that cap length.

long_description.description: ~150-word description. Agents must vary the opener per directory — never paste this identically twice.

one_liner.description: Meta-description-length summary (optional but useful for Twitter-card style fields).

tags.description: Category tag pool. Agents pick 5–8 per directory and must not repeat the exact set twice in a row.

png.description: Path or URL to an inspected PNG logo; convert SVG to PNG if needed.

svg.description: Path or URL to SVG logo.

square.description: Path or URL to square 1024x1024 logo.

screenshots.description: Optional real product screenshots; gather when a selected directory requires them.

demo_video.description: 60–90s demo video URL, or null if none yet.

has_pricing_page.description: Whether a public pricing page was found; check each directory's actual requirement.

pricing_model.description: Value for forms with a pricing dropdown, e.g. 'Freemium', 'Free', 'Usage-based', 'Paid'.

starting_price.description: Only if a form forces a number. Keep consistent across submissions.

founder_story.description: 2–3 sentence origin story for fields that ask why you built it.

alternatives.description: Competitors. Used for 'alternative to' fields and Variant B copy.

not.description: Things the product is NOT (e.g. 'not an MCP server'). Prevents wrong-category submissions.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims that must never appear in copy (unverified stats, named customers, etc.).

contact.description: Local-only. NEVER write these into catalog files, reports you share, or screenshots.

email.description: The email the user chose for directory accounts and contact fields.

footer_badge_file.description: Repo path of the file holding reciprocal badge links (e.g. site-footer.tsx). Agents flag required badge deploys here but never edit prod code unattended.
